body.zh-Hant: 1874年7月7日生於波蘭的博魯夫（Borów）。他在巴黎讀政治學，在哈雷（Halle）讀農學。《義大利百科全書》的條目寫道，他1905年當選俄國杜馬代表，任職至1912年。
body.en: Born at Borów on 7 July 1874. He studied political science in Paris and agronomy at Halle. The Enciclopedia Italiana says he was elected a deputy to the Russian Duma in 1905 and remained a member until 1912.

citations.quote: nato a Borów il 7 luglio 1874
Studium Politikwissenschaft Paris, Agronomie Halle
Nel 1905 fu eletto deputato alla Duma russa
fino al 1912

heading.zh-Hant: 制憲議會、財政部長與1920年內閣
heading.en: Constituent Sejm, finance minister and the 1920 cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 1919年1月他當選波蘭制憲議會代表，同年12月在列奧波德·斯庫爾斯基的內閣出任財政部長。1920年6月24日、布爾什維克入侵之際，他被任命為內閣總理，並代表波蘭出席斯帕會議；7月24日維托斯組成民族團結內閣時，他留任財政部長，但在年底前離職。
body.en: In January 1919 he was elected to the Polish Constituent Sejm and in December of that year took the finance portfolio in Leopold Skulski's cabinet. On 24 June 1920, at the time of the Bolshevik invasion, he was named president of the council and represented Poland at the Spa conference. When Witos formed the national-concentration cabinet on 24 July 1920 he stayed at the finance ministry, but left it before the end of the year.

von 1919 bis 1920 Finanzminister

body.zh-Hant: 他在1923年1月重新出任財政部長，進入西科爾斯基將軍的內閣，並因擬定整頓財政與經濟的計畫而受肯定；維托斯接任後他一度續任，數週後辭職。待維托斯內閣垮台，他受命組閣並再次兼任財政部長，任內推行貨幣改革，並讓波蘭銀行建立在自主的基礎上。1925年11月13日他隨全體內閣辭職，不久被任命為高等農業學校校長。他1938年3月1日在華沙去世。
body.en: In January 1923 he again took the finance portfolio in General Sikorski's cabinet and was credited with drafting the plan to restore the country's finances and economy. Under Witos he stayed on for a time but resigned after a few weeks. When the Witos cabinet fell he was charged with forming a new government and again took the finance ministry; in that period he carried out the monetary reform and put the Bank of Poland on an autonomous footing. He resigned with the whole cabinet on 13 November 1925 and soon afterwards was named rector of the higher agricultural school. He died in Warsaw on 1 March 1938.

heading.en: The Democratic Party and the first government

body.zh-Hant: 1912年他出任左翼自由派、反教權的民主黨（Partido Democrático）主席。1913年1月，他終於領導一個只由民主黨人組成的政府；由於在國會是少數，仍須依賴參議院中統一派的支持。GND 記錄他在1913至1917年三度出任葡萄牙首相。
body.en: In 1912 he became chairman of the left-liberal, anticlerical Democratic Party (Partido Democrático). In January 1913 he at last led a government made up solely of Democrats; being a minority in Congress, it relied on the Unionists' support in the Senate. The GND records that he was Portuguese prime minister three times between 1913 and 1917.

heading.en: War, the peace conference and exile

body.zh-Hant: 1916年他主張葡萄牙站在協約國一方參戰。1919年他是葡萄牙出席巴黎和會代表團的團長。1917年西多尼奧·派斯發動軍事政變之後，以及1926年5月28日政變之後，他都因反對薩拉查式的獨裁而流亡法國。他1937年5月11日在巴黎去世。
body.en: In 1916 he advocated Portugal's entry into the war on the side of the Entente. In 1919 he headed the Portuguese delegation to the Paris Peace Conference. After Sidónio Pais's military coup in 1917, and again after the coup of 28 May 1926, he lived in exile in France as an opponent of the Salazar dictatorship. He died in Paris on 11 May 1937.

body.zh-Hant: 1868年9月6日生於圖爾高州魏因費爾登，1887年起在蘇黎世攻讀法律，之後轉往萊比錫與柏林繼續。1891年他取得圖爾高州的律師執照，1892年在魏因費爾登開設律師事務所，1894年把事務所遷到弗勞恩費爾德。
body.en: Born in Weinfelden on 6 September 1868. From 1887 he studied law in Zurich and continued in Leipzig and Berlin. He obtained the Thurgau lawyer's licence in 1891, opened a law practice in Weinfelden in 1892, and moved it to Frauenfeld in 1894.

die er 1894 nach Frauenfeld verlegte

body.zh-Hant: 1899至1920年他擔任弗勞恩費爾德地區法院院長。政黨方面，1908至1915年他出任圖爾高州自由派（Freisinn）的黨主席，1911至1920年屬於瑞士全國性政黨的中央委員會。議會方面，他1904至1920年是國民院議員，其中1918至1919年任國民院議長，1905至1920年另在圖爾高州議會任職。
body.en: From 1899 to 1920 he was president of the Frauenfeld district court. In party politics he presided over the Thurgau Freisinn (liberals) from 1908 to 1915 and from 1911 to 1920 sat on the central committee of the Swiss party. He was a member of the National Council from 1904 to 1920, serving as its president in 1918-19, and also sat in the Thurgau cantonal council from 1905 to 1920.

citations.quote: 1899-1920 war er Präs. des Bezirksgerichts Frauenfeld
1908-15 stand er dem thurg. Freisinn als Präsident vor
gehörte 1911-20 dem Zentralkomitee der schweiz. Partei an
1904-20 sass er im Nationalrat (Präs. 1918-19)
1905-20 im Thurgauer Kantonsrat

body.zh-Hant: 1920年2月12日他當選聯邦委員會（Bundesrat）委員，主管司法與警察部，並於1926年與1931年出任聯邦主席。他的名字主要連結到兩項被否決的國家安全立法：1922年的《顛覆法》（Lex Häberlin I）與1934年的《秩序法》（Lex Häberlin II）；第二項被否決後，他於1934年辭職。他任內更重要的工作是統一刑法，現代瑞士刑法雖到1942年才施行，主要建立在他的前期準備上。
body.en: He was elected to the Federal Council on 12 February 1920 and headed the Justice and Police Department, serving as Federal President in 1926 and 1931. His name is mainly tied to two failed state-protection bills: the 1922 Umsturzgesetz (Lex Häberlin I) and the 1934 Ordnungsgesetz (Lex Häberlin II). After the second was rejected he resigned in 1934. His more central achievement in office was the unification of criminal law; the modern Swiss penal code took effect only in 1942 but rested largely on his groundwork.

entstandene Umsturzgesetz (sog. Lex Häberlin I)

trat er 1934 zurück
Zentraler als der Staatsschutz war
Vereinheitlichung des Strafgesetzes

body.zh-Hant: 卸任聯邦委員後，他擔任瑞士文化基金會（Pro Helvetia）主席（1939至1944年），也長期主持聯邦自然與鄉土保護委員會與青少年福利基金會的董事會。他於1947年2月26日在弗勞恩費爾德去世。
body.en: After leaving the Federal Council he presided over Pro Helvetia (1939-44) and chaired the federal nature and heritage protection commission and the Pro Juventute foundation board. He died in Frauenfeld on 26 February 1947.
